title: BlogStudio Media Manifest
description: Per-post media.yaml declaring an audio or video resource for podcast/screencast posts.

url.description: External hosting URL. Media files are NOT stored in the repo.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds; used for the duration label across adapters

thumbnail_url.description: Thumbnail image URL (often required for video embeds)

transcript_path.description: Path to transcript.md relative to the post directory. Adapters that don't support native transcripts will append/link this.

host.description: Hosting platform (e.g., 'anchor.fm', 'youtube', 'vimeo'). Adapters may use this to pick the right embed shortcode.
